children: The finance executive moves from his role as vice president and business area controller for electrification after more than 28 years of experience

ABB India has promoted Suneel Kumar Munaga as its Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel, effective 1 January 2027. He currently serves as Vice President and Business Area Controller for Electrification at the company. Munaga brings more than 28 years of experience in finance, corporate governance, strategic planning and performance management to the role.

Munaga joined ABB in December 2004 as a manager, handling financial reporting, audit coordination, internal controls and payables and receivables management. After a brief stint at Tecumseh Products Company, he returned to a senior finance role at NTPC in August 2008, where he worked until February 2013.

He rejoined ABB in February 2013 and has since held leadership responsibilities in business finance. As Business Area Controller for Electrification, he has overseen financial performance, profit and loss, balance sheets, budgeting, taxation, compliance and key performance indicators for business units with an annual turnover of around Rs 3,700 cr.

During his tenure, he contributed to initiatives aimed at improving business performance, including efforts to move the business from operating losses to break-even and profitability. His responsibilities have also included product pricing, supplier pricing and process-efficiency projects.

Before his current role at ABB, Munaga served as Senior Manager at NTPC, where he was involved in accounts finalisation, internal and statutory audits, government audit coordination and statutory tax compliance. He also contributed to the automation of the bills-payable system and the establishment of the finance function for a project.

Earlier, at Tecumseh Products Company, he handled business planning, forecasting, management information systems (MIS), product costing, inventory valuation and financial reporting under Indian and US accounting standards. He also supported audit processes and the implementation of a global enterprise resource planning system.
His early career included a role at Hansen Drives, where he worked on setting up costing and MIS functions, as well as an initial stint at ABB.

Munaga holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree from Sri Venkateswara University and is a Certified Management Accountant from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. He completed the institute’s final examinations with an All India 13th rank and also attended a finance leadership programme at IMD.
His experience across financial control, business planning, cost management and operational performance will form part of his remit as CFO. The appointment takes effect at the beginning of 2027.
